resources.string: Connect an account only to execute Pro Chart signals. Credentials travel to the server over HTTPS and are never stored by the app.

What you enter here is setup input, not proof of a connection. Connected state comes only from the server and the venue; if verification does not arrive, execution stays pending rather than being guessed locally.
Create an LBank API key with only the permission you need: spot or futures. Withdrawal permission is not required. Saving a key does not mean the exchange has verified it.
LBank has no test environment. Any key saved here is a key to your real account, and any order placed from the app is executed with real money.
No exchange connection on this platform

This platform does not place orders from the app and takes no exchange key. A forex trading account is linked on the CoinePro-FX platform — broker, server, account number and trading password — and there is nothing to set up here.
A forex account is not connected here. The forex side does not use API keys; a MetaTrader 5 account is linked on the CoinePro-FX platform, on this same Connections screen.
Saved; the exchange has not verified it yet. Execution stays queued until LBank confirms.
Create the key in LBank without withdrawal permission. If the key is ever exposed, that is the one thing standing between it and your funds.
This account\'s details are cleared and any copying running from it stops. We do not keep those details anywhere, so reconnecting means entering them again.
Link your MetaTrader 5 account so the copy service can open Pro Chart trades on it. Credentials travel to the server over HTTPS and are never stored by the app.

What you enter here is setup input, not proof of a connection. Connected state arrives only once a terminal reports in on this same account; until then the link stays pending rather than being guessed locally.
The same details you sign into the MetaTrader 5 terminal with: broker, server, account number and account password.

This password is sent to the server so the terminal can sign into your account. An Investor password is not enough — it has to be the trading account\'s own password, so enter it with the care a real password deserves.
Details saved; no terminal has reported in on this account yet. Copying does not run on it until one does.
The terminal is signed into account %1$s, not the one linked here. Until they match, the server withholds this account\'s positions and copying does not run on it.
There is no active subscription on this account.
Reading the connection state is behind a subscription; linking an account is not. You can send the details now, but until you hold a subscription nothing here will say what the server did with them.
Details sent. The outcome is not readable here, because reading the state needs a subscription.
This is the same link the copy-trading screen runs on: the account is connected once and the service opens the trades on it.
